verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cooley GO offering free self-serve document generators (incorporation package, YC Safe, Series Seed) and guidance content. None of it documents a fee arrangement for legal representation, such as deferred fees, fixed-fee formation pricing, or a named startup program with stated commercial terms. Free templates are an adjacent resource, not a published fee package, so they earn no credit for this fee-transparency story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes a startup package — deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms — on its own pages
